title: Task-Specific Pipelines
summary: This module provides specialized pipeline classes for common NLP and multimodal tasks, building upon a chunking base to handle large inputs efficiently. It includes pipelines for Automatic Speech Recognition, Document Question Answering, and Image-Text-to-Text generation.

nodes.label: Chunk Processing Base
nodes.title: ChunkPipeline
nodes.description: Provides a base class for pipelines that process large inputs by dividing them into smaller chunks, managing iteration, and batching for efficient processing.

nodes.label: Automatic Speech Recognition
nodes.title: AutomaticSpeechRecognitionPipeline
nodes.description: Transcribes spoken audio into text, handling various audio formats, chunking for long inputs, and supporting language model integration for enhanced decoding.

nodes.label: Document Question Answering
nodes.title: DocumentQuestionAnsweringPipeline
nodes.description: Extracts answers to questions from document images, optionally performing OCR to identify words and their bounding boxes for models like LayoutLM.

nodes.label: Image-Text-to-Text Generation
nodes.title: ImageTextToTextPipeline
nodes.description: Generates text based on an image and an optional text prompt, supporting conversational models and various input formats including chat structures.

nodes.label: Pretrained Model
nodes.title: PreTrainedModel
nodes.description: A generic pretrained model used by the pipelines for inference, adapted to specific tasks like ASR, DQA, or image-text generation.

nodes.label: Feature Extractor
nodes.title: SequenceFeatureExtractor
nodes.description: Processes raw input data (e.g., audio waveforms) into features suitable for model input.

nodes.label: Tokenizer
nodes.title: PreTrainedTokenizer
nodes.description: Converts text into numerical tokens and vice-versa, handling special tokens and padding for model compatibility.

nodes.label: Image Processor
nodes.title: ImageProcessor
nodes.description: Preprocesses images, performing operations like resizing, normalization, and format conversion for model input.

nodes.label: Audio Input
nodes.title: Audio Data
nodes.description: Raw audio data (file, bytes, or numpy array) provided by the user for transcription.

nodes.label: Document Image Input
nodes.title: Document Image
nodes.description: An image of a document, potentially with associated word bounding boxes, used for question answering.

nodes.label: Text Prompt Input
nodes.title: Text Prompt
nodes.description: Textual input or conversational history provided to guide text generation.

nodes.label: OCR System (Tesseract)
nodes.title: Tesseract OCR
nodes.description: An external Optical Character Recognition engine used by DQA to extract text and bounding boxes from document images if not provided.

nodes.label: Language Model Decoder
nodes.title: PyCTCDecode BeamSearchDecoderCTC
nodes.description: An external beam search decoder that can be integrated with CTC models in ASR for language model boosted decoding.

nodes.label: Transcribed Text Output
nodes.title: Transcribed Text
nodes.description: The generated text output from the Automatic Speech Recognition pipeline.

nodes.label: QA Answer Output
nodes.title: QA Answer
nodes.description: The extracted answer and its confidence score from the Document Question Answering pipeline.

nodes.label: Generated Text Output
nodes.title: Generated Text
nodes.description: The text generated by the Image-Text-to-Text pipeline based on image and text prompts.

groups.label: Pipeline Base Classes
groups.title: Pipeline Base Classes
groups.description: Foundational classes providing common functionalities for various pipelines.

groups.label: Task-Specific Pipelines
groups.title: Task-Specific Pipelines
groups.description: Pipelines tailored for specific machine learning tasks, extending base functionalities.

groups.label: Core ML Components
groups.title: Core ML Components
groups.description: Essential machine learning components utilized by the pipelines for processing and generation.

groups.label: External Systems
groups.title: External Systems
groups.description: Third-party tools or libraries integrated into the pipelines for specialized functionalities.

groups.label: Pipeline Inputs
groups.title: Pipeline Inputs
groups.description: Various types of data that serve as input to the task-specific pipelines.

groups.label: Pipeline Outputs
groups.title: Pipeline Outputs
groups.description: The results produced by the task-specific pipelines after processing the inputs.
